how.lead: 1 = issued the day before the target day (capture date + 1); 2 and 3 likewise. Same-day (lead 0) forecasts are never graded.
how.temps: err_high / err_low = forecast minus the station's measured high/low for the target day (°F; the cloud's per-minute copy of the backyard Tempest). Standings MAE = mean of |err| over high AND low.
how.rain: rain = 'hit' | 'miss' | 'false alarm' | 'correct dry': PoP >= 50% counts as calling rain; the day is wet when the Tempest cloud day total (the app's NC Rain) OR the CoCoRaHS GA-OC-20 gauge (~2.6 mi away, report shifted back a day) reached 0.01". CSI = hits / (hits + misses + false alarms).
how.sources: PUBLIC: NBM, NWS, ECMWF, GFS. HOUSE: Dawg (the 05:35 AI call; fallback-blend days are not scored as Dawg) and Blend (the deterministic rule, back-filled). Tempest = the subject.
